{{Top|leg}}
The '''House of Holowan''' was the name of the Holowan residence in [[Kuat City]]. It was the site where [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] captured [[Hurlo Holowan]].

The house was surrounded by a large moat and was capped with a pyramid-shaped roof. The upper floors of the residence were visible from a [[Hovertrain/Legends|hovertrain]] stop, one block to the south, along [[Holowan Terrace]].

*''[[Star Wars Adventures 5: The Shape-Shifter Strikes]]''
